versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֡י בְּיוֹם֩ כַּלּ֨וֹת מֹשֶׁ֜ה לְהָקִ֣ים אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֹת֜וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וַיִּמְשָׁחֵ֖ם וַיְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;
controles.kjv: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
controles.livre: E aconteceu, que quando Moisés acabou de levantar o tabernáculo, e o ungido, e o santificado, com todos os seus utensílios; e também ungido e santificado o altar, com todos os seus utensílios;

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם הֵ֚ם נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַמַּטֹּ֔ת הֵ֥ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עַל־הַפְּקֻדִֽים׃

controles.web: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were numbered:
controles.kjv: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
controles.livre: Então os príncipes de Israel, os chefes das casas de seus pais, os quais eram os príncipes das tribos, que estavam sobre os contados, ofereceram;

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־עֶגְלֹ֥ת צָב֙ וּשְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֔ר עֲגָלָ֛ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים וְשׁ֣וֹר לְאֶחָ֑ד וַיַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אוֹתָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they presented them before the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
controles.livre: E trouxeram suas ofertas diante do SENHOR, seis carros cobertos, e doze bois; por cada dois príncipes um carro, e cada um deles um boi; o qual ofereceram diante do tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: קַ֚ח מֵֽאִתָּ֔ם וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ כְּפִ֥י עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”
controles.kjv: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
controles.livre: Toma-o deles, e será para o serviço do tabernáculo do testemunho: e o darás aos levitas, a cada um conforme seu ministério.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־הָעֲגָלֹ֖ת וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֑ר וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖ם אֶל־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
controles.kjv: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
controles.livre: Então Moisés recebeu os carros e os bois, e deu-os aos levitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ת׀ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ אַרְבַּ֣עַת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן כְּפִ֖י עֲבֹדָתָֽם׃

controles.web: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
controles.kjv: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
controles.livre: Dois carros e quatro bois, deu aos filhos de Gérson, conforme seu ministério;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣ת׀ אַרְבַּ֣ע הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ שְׁמֹנַ֣ת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י כְּפִי֙ עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

controles.web: and he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
controles.kjv: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Merari deu os quatro carros e oito bois, conforme seu ministério, sob a mão de Itamar, filho de Arão o sacerdote.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לֹ֣א נָתָ֑ן כִּֽי־עֲבֹדַ֤ת הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ עֲלֵהֶ֔ם בַּכָּתֵ֖ף יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃

controles.web: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.
controles.kjv: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Coate não deu; porque levavam sobre si nos ombros o serviço do santuário.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ הַנְּשִׂאִ֗ים אֵ֚ת חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּקְרִ֧יבוּ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֛ם אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes gave their offerings before the altar.
controles.kjv: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
controles.livre: E ofereceram os príncipes à dedicação do altar o dia que foi ungido, ofereceram os príncipes sua oferta diante do altar.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה נָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד לַיּ֗וֹם נָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לַיּ֔וֹם יַקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֔ם לַחֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ס

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Oferecerão sua oferta, um príncipe um dia, e outro príncipe outro dia, à dedicação do altar.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י הַמַּקְרִ֛יב בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן אֶת־קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ נַחְשׁ֥וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָ֖ב לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,
controles.kjv: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
controles.livre: E o que ofereceu sua oferta o primeiro dia foi Naassom filho de Aminadabe, da tribo de Judá.

versos.hebraico: וְקָרְבָּנ֞וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒ מִזְרָ֤ק אֶחָד֙ כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעִ֥ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם׀ מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃

controles.web: and his offering was:   one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels,   one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;
controles.kjv: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
controles.livre: E foi sua oferta um prato de prata de peso de cento e trinta siclos, e uma bacia de prata de setenta siclos, ao siclo do santuário; ambos cheios de flor de farinha amassada com azeite para oferta de cereais;

versos.hebraico: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃

controles.web: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
controles.kjv: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
controles.livre: Uma colher de ouro de dez siclos, cheia de incenso;

versos.hebraico: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: one young bull,   one ram,   one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
controles.kjv: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
controles.livre: Um bezerro, um carneiro, um cordeiro de ano para holocausto;

versos.hebraico: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽאת׃

controles.web: one male goat for a sin offering;
controles.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
controles.livre: Um bode macho para expiação;

versos.hebraico: וּלְזֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ בָּקָ֣ר שְׁנַיִם֒ אֵילִ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַתּוּדִ֣ים חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֖ה חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה זֶ֛ה קָרְבַּ֥ן נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃פ

controles.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
controles.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
controles.livre: E para sacrifício pacífico, dois bois, cinco carneiros, cinco machos de bode, cinco cordeiros de ano. Esta foi a oferta de Naassom, filho de Aminadabe.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י הִקְרִ֖יב נְתַנְאֵ֣ל בֶּן־צוּעָ֑ר נְשִׂ֖יא יִשָּׂשכָֽר׃

controles.web: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.
controles.kjv: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
controles.livre: No segundo dia ofereceu Natanael filho de Zuar, príncipe de Issacar.

controles.kjv: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

controles.kjv: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
controles.livre: Uma colher de ouro de dez siclos, cheia de incenso;

controles.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
controles.livre: E para sacrifício pacífico, dois bois, cinco carneiros, cinco machos de bode, cinco cordeiros de ano. Esta foi a oferta de Natanael, filho de Zuar.

controles.livre: No terceiro dia, Eliabe filho de Helom, príncipe dos filhos de Zebulom:

controles.kjv: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
controles.livre: As doze colheres de ouro cheias de incenso, de dez siclos cada colher, ao siclo do santuário: todo o ouro das colheres, cento e vinte siclos.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַבָּקָ֨ר לָעֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר֙ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּמִנְחָתָ֑ם וּשְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֛ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃

controles.web: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and the male goats for a sin offering twelve;
controles.kjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
controles.livre: Todos os bois para holocausto, doze bezerros; doze os carneiros, doze os cordeiros de ano, com sua oferta de cereais: e doze os machos de bode, para expiação.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר׀ זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒ אֵילִ֤ם שִׁשִּׁים֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים שִׁשִּׁ֔ים כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֑ים זֹ֚את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אַחֲרֵ֖י הִמָּשַׁ֥ח אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the male lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.
controles.kjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
controles.livre: E todos os bois do sacrifício pacífico vinte e quatro novilhos, sessenta os carneiros, sessenta os machos de bode, sessenta os cordeiros de ano. Esta foi a dedicação do altar, depois que foi ungido.

versos.hebraico: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּוֹ֒ וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת־הַקּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מֵעַ֤ל הַכַּפֹּ֨רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽיו׃פ

controles.web: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spoke to him.
controles.kjv: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
controles.livre: E quando entrava Moisés no tabernáculo do testemunho, para falar com Ele, ouvia a Voz que lhe falava de cima do propiciatório que estava sobre a arca do testemunho, dentre os dois querubins: e falava com ele.
